value.title: Opus-5 Adaptation: Tiered Prompts, Deterministic Pre-Gate, Stronger Completion Gate
value.description: Adapt agent-bober’s prompt and pipeline architecture to Opus-5-class models without weakening verification, and without degrading weaker providers that share the same prompts. Adds model-tier-aware prompt loading, a deterministic short-circuit strategy pre-gate, a completion gate that catches deferred/partial work, and removes sequential dead time from the per-sprint chain.

features.title: Current model aliases and per-role effort
features.description: Refresh SHORTHAND_MAP to the Claude 5 generation and set per-role output_config.effort defaults, plus stage-level timing telemetry to establish a measurable baseline.
acceptanceCriteria: AC1: When a config names `opus` or `sonnet`, it resolves to claude-opus-5 / claude-sonnet-5 respectively.
AC2: When a config names an unmapped string, it still passes through unchanged to the anthropic provider.
AC3: When a role has an effort value, the Anthropic request body carries output_config.effort; when it does not, no output_config key is emitted.
AC4: Each pipeline stage emits a start/end timing event to .bober/history.jsonl so per-stage latency can be compared to the 18.2 min baseline.

features.title: Model-tier-aware prompt loading
features.description: Resolve a prompt tier from the role’s resolved model (table + config override) and load agents/<name>.<tier>.md with fallback to agents/<name>.md.
acceptanceCriteria: AC1: When the resolved model is absent from the tier table, the tier is "full".
AC2: When a role sets promptTier in config, it overrides the table.
AC3: When agents/<name>.<tier>.md does not exist, the loader falls back to agents/<name>.md.
AC4: With no .lean.md files on disk, every loaded prompt is byte-identical to the pre-change behaviour.

features.title: Deterministic strategy pre-gate
features.description: A plain strategy runner that executes the configured typecheck/lint/unit-test/build/api-check commands, wired as a short-circuiting pre-gate ahead of the evaluator LLM.
acceptanceCriteria: AC1: When a required strategy fails, the sprint is marked needs-rework and the evaluator subagent is never spawned.
AC2: When a strategy has no configured command, it is reported skipped rather than failed.
AC3: When all required strategies pass, their output is passed into the evaluator prompt.
AC4: Iteration accounting and retry semantics are unchanged from today.

features.title: Completion gate against deferred work
features.description: Generator contract clause requiring the whole task be finished, plus an evaluator criterion that fails partial implementations and deferred work which currently pass typecheck and build.
acceptanceCriteria: AC1: When the generator defers work (“I’ll do X later”, TODO stubs, unimplemented branches) the evaluator emits a failing completeness verdict even though typecheck and build pass.
AC2: When the sprint is genuinely complete, the completeness verdict passes and does not add a false failure.
AC3: The generator prompt carries an explicit finish-the-whole-task / no-premature-done clause.
AC4: The completeness verdict appears as a distinct, addressable entry in the EvalResult.

features.title: Lean prompts for the hot-path agents
features.description: Hand-authored lean variants of the generator, evaluator and curator prompts, selected automatically for Claude 5 models.
acceptanceCriteria: AC1: Each lean variant preserves its agent’s output JSON contract exactly.
AC2: Each lean variant retains the feat-4 completion clause.
AC3: The corresponding full variants are unmodified.
AC4: With generator on claude-opus-5, the loader selects the lean variant.

features.title: Remove sequential dead time
features.description: Make the curator conditional on sprint size and run the post-evaluator review chain concurrently.
acceptanceCriteria: AC1: When a sprint is below the configured curator threshold, the curator is skipped and the skip is logged.
AC2: Above the threshold, curator behaviour including the existing-briefing short-circuit is unchanged.
AC3: Code-reviewer, security-auditor and security-verifier run concurrently under a bounded limit.
AC4: A failure in one reviewer does not cancel the others, and the security gate verdict semantics are unchanged.

assumptions: `.claude/commands/*.md` is a GENERATED artifact, not hand-maintained: scripts/update-all.mjs:55 (inlineSkill) concatenates SKILL.md + sorted references, byte-identical to installClaudeCommands in src/cli/commands/init.ts. Re-derived all 46 skills; 34/46 are byte-identical today and the other 12 are absent, not divergent.

Config `model` fields accept literal model IDs, not just shorthands: src/config/schema.ts:19 (ModelChoiceSchema) and :22 (GeneratorModelSchema) are both z.string().min(1). Verified by loading the real bober.config.json through dist/config/loader.js.

`effort` is fully plumbed but never set: declared at src/providers/types.ts:162, optional on four role configs at src/config/schema.ts:109,124,151,183, emitted at src/providers/anthropic.ts:369 only when defined. bober.config.json contains no effort key, so every role runs at the API default.
agent-loader.ts has zero model/provider awareness: src/orchestrator/agent-loader.ts:108-159 resolves agents/<name>.md by project-override then bundled path only.
No deterministic strategy runner exists anywhere in src/: src/cli/commands/eval.ts:6,142 delegates straight to runEvaluatorAgent; configured strategies are executed by the LLM shelling out.
The post-evaluator review chain is sequential: src/orchestrator/pipeline.ts:431 (evaluator), :577 (runCodeReviewer), with runWithAudit wrappers at :566 and :647.
The retry loop rarely fires under the current gate: .bober/history.jsonl shows 194/213 sprints passing on iteration 1, 19 on iteration 2, 0 ever reaching iteration 3.
Latency baseline from .bober/history.jsonl (197 sprint-started -> sprint-completed pairs): median 18.2 min, mean 29.0, p75 24.5, p90 46.5, max 225.1; 95.1h total.
The tokensave code graph is enabled (bober.config.json graph.enabled=true), so the curator subagent duplicates context-gathering the graph can already serve.

Multiple non-Anthropic providers are live and share one prompt set: src/orchestrator/model-resolver.ts:22-45 maps openai/google/openai-compat/ollama, and src/fleet/tier-policy.ts:27-34 routes tiers to DeepSeek and Grok.
Prompt-tier policy (user-selected): a built-in model->tier table with an optional per-role promptTier config override, and unknown models falling back to "full" so nothing regresses.
Gate placement (user-selected): the strategy runner is a PRE-gate that short-circuits: a required-strategy failure marks needs-rework without spawning the evaluator LLM at all.
Lean-variant scope (user-selected): generator, evaluator and curator only, which account for ~89KB of the ~155KB per-sprint static prompt load.
outOfScope: Lowering evaluator.maxIterations (explicitly withdrawn: a stricter completion gate should raise the retry rate, not lower it).
Blanket de-prescribing of skills/*/SKILL.md step-by-step orchestration recipes: they are shared with weaker providers and cutting them globally would degrade DeepSeek/Grok/ollama runs.
Lean prompt variants for the other 15 agents (planner, architect, documenter, code-reviewer, security-*, seo-*, design-*). Deferred to a follow-up plan once the mechanism is measured.
Adding a `thinking` parameter to the Anthropic adapter: thinking is on by default on claude-opus-5 and no need has been demonstrated.

Restructuring skills/ vs .claude/commands/: it is a generated artifact and the only real gap is running `npm run update-all` to emit the 11 missing bober.seo-* commands. Tracked as a chore, not a sprint.
Any change to the OpenAI, Google, or openai-compat provider adapters.
Cost-optimisation or model-downgrade decisions; this plan changes latency and gate strength, not spend policy.

resolvedClarifications.answer: Built-in model->tier table plus optional per-role promptTier config override; unknown models fall back to "full".
Strategy runner is a pre-gate that short-circuits on required failure, skipping the evaluator LLM spawn entirely.
Hand-author lean variants for generator, evaluator and curator only.

integrationPoints: tokensave code graph (graph.enabled=true) as the curator’s replacement context source
techNotes.dataModel: No persistent schema change. New optional config keys: <role>.promptTier, curator threshold. New history.jsonl event types for stage timing, strategy pre-gate outcome, and curator skip.
securityConsiderations: The strategy runner executes commands from bober.config.json — it must not widen what is already executed by the evaluator agent today, and must not interpolate untrusted contract text into a shell.
Parallelising the security chain must not change the fail-closed semantics of the security gate.
techNotes.existingPatterns: Follow the existing agent-loader project-override-then-bundled resolution order, the emit() telemetry helper used at src/orchestrator/evaluator-agent.ts:59, and the runWithAudit wrapper pattern in pipeline.ts.

nonFunctionalRequirements.requirement: No behaviour change for any non-Anthropic provider; DeepSeek/Grok/ollama/OpenAI/Google roles continue to load the full prompt set.
nonFunctionalRequirements.verificationMethod: Unit tests asserting tier resolution returns "full" for every non-Claude-5 model id in SHORTHAND_MAP.

nonFunctionalRequirements.requirement: The verification gate must not weaken: no change may reduce the set of conditions that fail a sprint.
nonFunctionalRequirements.verificationMethod: Fixture-based tests: an incomplete-but-compiling sprint must fail after this plan and is expected to pass before it.

nonFunctionalRequirements.requirement: Median sprint wall-clock should improve against the 18.2 min baseline, measured over recorded sprints after feat-3 and feat-6 land.
nonFunctionalRequirements.verificationMethod: Compare stage-level timing events in .bober/history.jsonl before and after; report medians rather than single runs.

nonFunctionalRequirements.requirement: Every new behaviour is opt-in or defaults to current behaviour, so a bad tier table or threshold cannot silently break existing projects.
nonFunctionalRequirements.verificationMethod: Tests asserting default-path equivalence with no new config keys present.

metadata.riskNotes: Sprints 3-4 (strategy pre-gate) and 8 (parallel review chain) touch the pipeline control flow that every sprint depends on. Both are gated behind default-preserving behaviour and fixture tests. Sprint 5 deliberately makes the gate stricter, which is expected to raise the retry rate.
